statementAttestation.inputConstraintExcerpt: The overall number of characters (including letters and spaces) does not exceed 105.
semanticsConfirmed: Exactly one nonempty lowercase Latin word line; exactly one space between consecutive words and no other spaces.
The whole word may consist solely of one of the six endings.
A sentence is either exactly one valid language word or one statement.
A statement is zero or more adjectives, exactly one noun, zero or more verbs, all one gender.
statementAttestation.accessLimitations: codeforces.com returned HTTP 403; mirror.codeforces.com timed out. cf-p.vercel.app returned its proxy landing/access page, not a statement, and was not used. Public codeforces.me HTML supplies original English sections and explicit exponent markup.

normalizationProposal.attestation: 10<sup class="upper-index">5</sup> in the English input specification of the SHA-bound public HTML.
normalizationProposal.scope: Parent may normalize derived statement after preserving original; this author changes no imported statement/sample/test/source bytes.

constraints.alphabet: a-z and a single ASCII space between words
constraints.lineTerminator: Absent (samples), LF or CRLF accepted; terminator excluded from character budget; no other whitespace accepted.
constraints.output: Exactly one token YES or NO; unique answer, no floating or custom checker.

oracle.efficient: For every word recognize only its final ending. Reject unknown endings and mixed gender. A single recognized word is YES. Otherwise require nondecreasing adjective/noun/verb phase and exactly one noun. O(total input characters), O(number of words) parsed data, O(1) oracle auxiliary space.
oracle.independentReference: Three directly encoded whole-sentence regular grammars: one valid word, masculine adjective* noun verb*, feminine adjective* noun verb*. Uses fullmatch on the complete text, never calls suffix classification or phase logic.
plannedBruteDomains: Exhaust all lengths 1..5 over six suffix-only valid words plus invalid a (19607 sequences).
Exhaust all one-word strings of lengths 1..4 over aeilnorst (7380 words).
All 160 generated cases, including legal maximum-size cases, checked by the independent whole-sentence grammars.

generatedSuite.coverage: Six single-ending words and minimum invalid word; exhaustive 49 two-word combinations; both genders with 0..3 adjectives/verbs; late/multiple/missing noun, mixed gender, invalid early/middle/final words, internal endings, proper ending prefixes; fixed-seed small random sequences; twelve exactly-100000-character cases including 50000-word maximum.
generatedSuite.qualificationStatus: Authored cases only. No 5AC/5-genuine-WA or sixth external oracle execution and no independent signoff.

sourceMotivatedCoverage.observation: re.match(r'1*23*', words) accepts a prefix, without an end anchor. Suite includes a valid adjective/noun/verb prefix followed by an adjective.
First word must be adjective/noun; no single-verb exception, and no final check requiring noun phase. Suite includes each single verb and multiple adjective-only words.
Loops check matching-gender endings, not noun count or part order. Suite exhausts two-word types and has missing/multiple nouns and reversed order.
d is overwritten on each word; earlier invalid words can be hidden by a later valid suffix. Suite places invalid words before a valid grammatical tail.

upstreamReview.reviewScope: Every supplied official/sample input passed exact layout/range parsing and every supplied expected output matched the efficient oracle. No malformed pairs or contradictions were observed; no source bytes or outputs were altered.
